candidates.name: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
support_spans: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
candidates.why: The presence of tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, and frequent mitotic figures suggests a malignant process.

candidates.name: Hepatocellular Adenoma
support_spans: multifocal basophilic foci located predominantly in the perilobular region
contradict_spans: local invasion into adjacent blood vessels was seen
candidates.why: The presence of basophilic foci and tumor cells with clear cell borders may suggest a benign process, but the presence of local invasion indicates a more aggressive process.

candidates.name: Hepatic Angiosarcoma
support_spans: Narrow spaces containing erythrocytes were noted between tumor cells
contradict_spans: The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
candidates.why: The presence of narrow spaces containing erythrocytes between tumor cells may suggest a vascular origin, but the cellular morphology is not typical of angiosarcoma.
